verdict.rationale: Version-upgrade guidance is a fair question for a UI framework, but the evidence pack has no official upgrade or migration guide for moving between SolidJS versions. One community comment only asks for a React-to-Solid migration section, which is a different capability. Another worries about possible 2.0 breaking changes, which says nothing about upgrade documentation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can follow an official upgrade guide to move my existing project to a newer version
